title: Runs of SUBTRACT and INVERT
text: Sequences of SUBTRACT and INVERT objects in a LAYER and everything that can interrupt them: normal children, cutters, nested LAYERs and cached children.
notes: Known difference, the same on every renderer: where a later object covers a SUBTRACT or INVERT pixel drawn over nothing, Flash shows the hidden mode result (opaque black or white) and OpenFL the object as it is, up to 3.1% of a cell.
